events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding the lever means a 75% chance of death for me, so I want someone else to take that risk. Staying quiet and letting the ceiling drop a round keeps options open; pushing anyone risks nothing for me but they may be forced onto it. Best is to stay and watch who commits.

events.name: Cole
events.text: The current stage is the Crusher Room. My goal is to win the best prize, which means finishing 1st, 2nd, or 3rd. In this room, the door opens if someone holds the lever. The holder has a 25% chance to survive the ceiling collapse. If no one holds the lever by round 5, everyone bu

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm not holding that lever.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have anchor power so I can't be pushed onto the lever and have +1 footing. Safest to stay put and let others fight over holding or pushing. No need to volunteer or push yet.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I know the safe side of the bridge rows, but that's irrelevant now. I need to survive the crusher.

events.name: Eli
events.text: hold_lever

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Jam lever gives 50% survival vs 25% if I hold. Others will escape, I might survive.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Early holding is a 25% death sentence; better to let others fight over the lever. Pushing someone else keeps me off the hook if nobody volunteers, so I'll push a low-profile target rather than stay, which risks nothing but also does nothing.
Nobody should volunteer this early. Push Ash with me and we stay clear while someone else takes the lever.

events.name: Fenn
events.detail: Jammed the lever open; everyone else walks out, but the jaws catch the jammer.

events.note: 6 contestants fall into a pit that is slowly flooding.

events.name: Ash
events.text: No base yet, and I have no power. If I offer to be base, I risk being stuck unless rescued; better to wait and hope someone else volunteers, then climb out. I won't push anyone yet.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm down, no base yet. Offering to be base means I can never climb alone and just wait, which is a dead end for my score. Better to wait and see who volunteers, keeping my climb option open. Forger power is unspent; hold it.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I am Cole. I am currently in the pit, and I am not the base. The goal is to survive and get a prize (1, 2, or 3). I have the map power, which means I know all the rules in advance, but that doesn't directly help me in this specific turn's action choices. My only action is 'wait'

events.name: Dara
events.text: No base yet, round 1 of 5, flood low. My anchor power protects from push and crusher but here it's passive +1 footing, irrelevant now. Avoid being base; let others volunteer or push first, then climb out safely.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm down in the pit and not the base. I need to become the base or climb out.
offer_back, we both climb next round

events.name: Hana
events.text: Five of us down, no base, two climb out per round. I must not become the base. Push someone else down to be it; volunteers are random among volunteers, so pushing is my lever. Ash looks like a weak position to argue back.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Nobody volunteer. Someone gets picked as base either way — better it's chosen than volunteered into.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli is base. I need to climb out while I can. No reason to wait; climbing now is best.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli is base; climbing out is possible now, max 2 climbers per round. I want to get out early and avoid being pushed into base. Climb.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli has volunteered to be the base. My power is map and I know all rules in advance. I am currently in the pit and not the base. Eli whispered to me that we both climb next round. Eli said 'offer_back, we both climb next round'. This implies Eli wants me to climb next round, afte

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eli is base, so I can climb out now. Only 2 spots per round, Eli volunteered so probably reliable. Round 2/5, flood rising, better get out early to avoid risks. My anchor power helps later, safe here.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm the base and can't climb out alone. I need to wait and see if someone will rescue me.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm staying put as the base.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli is base, so climbing is open. Two spots per round with six of us down — go now to beat the odds and stay dry. Save the swap; it's useless while I'm the one moving.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli is base, Cole and Hana are out. I'm down with Bex and Dara. Two can climb this round; I should try to climb to secure a top spot. No value in waiting or pushing base since Eli is already base.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm climbing.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli is base. Climbing is available now, and only 2 lifts per round, so I should climb to get out while the spot is open. Cole and Hana already out; staying silent keeps rivals guessing.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I am Cole and my power is map. I am currently out of the pit. Eli has volunteered to be the base. Ash, Bex, and Dara are still down and need to climb. Hana and I are already out. The goal is to get a prize, which means places 1, 2, or 3. Eli is committed to being the base. To hel

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eli is base, Cole and Hana out. Flood at 2, 3 rounds left after this. I must climb out this round or next to beat the flood.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm the base and can't climb out. I need to wait and see if someone will rescue me.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Waiting here.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm already out. Throwing the rope saves Eli, a rival, at a footing cost to me in the final obstacle. No upside. I leave.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm out, rope is used, no reason to stay. Leaving is the only move that keeps me alive. I won't help anyone down there for free.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm already out. Only legal action is leave. Dara is down and may be pushed to base; no base, no rope usable by me. Nothing to gain by speaking much.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I am Cole. I just used the rope to save Eli. This means I am now out of the pit and the rope is gone. The current stage is the pit, and I am currently 'out'. My available actions are 'leave' or 'reach_down'. Since there is no base anymore (because I just hauled Eli out), 'reach_d

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm down, not base, my power gives +1 footing and protects from push/crush later. No rope left, flood at 3/5, round 4/5, need base to climb, only 2 can climb per round. Must offer_back to become base now, let others climb, then hope someone rescues with... wait no rope used alrea

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm out of the pit and need to decide my next move carefully.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Let's get out of here.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Rope is gone, Dara is the base and doomed. Nothing to gain by staying. Climb clear and save my strength for the last obstacle.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara, nobody can haul you now. Sorry. Rest of you: see you at the last obstacle.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm out and safe. No reason to use the rope unless it benefits me, but I owe no one. I'll leave and secure my position.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm out of the pit with only leave available. Dara is the lone one down; I can't affect that now. Forger power is unspent but forging could matter later; for now just leave.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I am Cole, and my power is map. I know all the rules in advance. The current stage is the pit, and I am out of the pit. Dara is down and cannot be helped. Hana also said she cannot help Dara. Eli is also down. The goal is to survive. I am currently out, and my only options are to

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm leaving.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Round 5/5, flood at 4, I'm down alone after failed climb. No base set, must volunteer or risk random force later but pit ends this round. My anchor power is passive/useless here. Best to offer_back to maybe enable a climb this round, though alone can't climb.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am out of the pit and need to decide whether to leave or help someone down.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Let's get out of here before it's too late.
Who do you think is the most likely to be the base?

events.name: Hana
events.text: Rope is used, Dara is stuck as base and cannot be hauled. Nothing to gain by staying. I leave and save myself for the final obstacle.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Nothing left to do here. See the survivors at the finish.

events.note: A disc of 5 tiles spins up; 2 will open.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Five of us left, two trapdoors. I want to pick a tile that's less likely to be crowded, but I can't know which will open. Random is random; just pick a number.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Five tiles, two open, three survive. Picking a tile is essentially a coin toss; collisions bump people randomly. I have a forge power I'll save for later. Pick a tile and stay quiet.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need to pick a tile to avoid elimination. Exactly 3 contestants survive, and 2 tiles will open as trapdoors. There are 5 contestants alive: Ash, Bex, Cole, Eli, Hana. I have knowledge of future stages, but that's not relevant for this round. I should try to pick a tile that oth

events.name: Cole
events.text: Choosing tile 3.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to choose a tile that maximizes my chance of survival. Since I don't know what others will choose, I'll pick a tile and hope for the best.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Let's spread out.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Five alive, five tiles, two drop after round 2. No information yet; tile choice is symmetric, so any tile is equal. Keep my swap power hidden until assignments are shown.

events.name: Hana
events.text: No point guessing yet. Show us the tiles, then we'll talk.

events.name: Ash
events.note: tile 3 was contested and went to Bex; placed on random free tile 1

events.name: Cole
events.note: tile 3 was contested and went to Bex; placed on random free tile 4

events.name: Eli
events.note: tile 3 was contested and went to Bex; placed on random free tile 2

events.name: Hana
events.note: tile 3 was contested and went to Bex; placed on random free tile 5

events.name: Ash
events.text: Two trapdoors will open among five tiles. My best odds are to stay on my tile; no action can change position. I'll stay quiet and hope the trapdoors avoid me.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Two of five tiles will open; 3 survive. I'm on tile 3. Nothing I can do but wait, and bluffing or forging is pointless now. Stay quiet and watch who talks.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I am Cole and my power is map. I know all stage rules in advance. The current stage is the Trapdoor Disc, Round 2. I previously chose tile 3. The state shows tiles 1=Ash, 2=Eli, 3=Bex, 4=Cole, 5=Hana. We need exactly 3 survivors, and 2 tiles will open as trapdoors. It's Round 2,

events.name: Cole
events.text: No more choices to make. We wait.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I know the tiles and my position. I should try to move to a safe tile.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Let's swap tiles to survive.
Swap with me, tile 3 is safe.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The trapdoor tiles are random and unknown, so swapping tiles gains me nothing but risk. Keep my power unspent unless someone offers real information.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Two random tiles fall. Swap talk is worthless unless someone knows something. If you do, name your price.

events.note: 3 contestants step onto the final ledge.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Three left, all footing 3. Eli offers a swap, which is worthless and a lie-prone pitch. Shoving exposes me; bracing is safe and free. Round 1 has no restriction, but I should keep options open. Bracing keeps my footing and avoids being shoved for loss.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Everyone starts with the same footing and no landed shoves. I should shove to gain an advantage.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Shoving will give us an edge.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Three of us left, all at 3 footing. Shoving exposes me to losses; the others may shove each other. Bracing is safe and punishes anyone who targets me, and I can dodge next round.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli shoved me last round, and I braced, so Eli is down to 2 footing. Shoving Eli now costs me nothing extra since I'm not exposed to a second shover, and Eli just used a shove so braces are not closed for me; I can brace or dodge. Hana is at 3 with no shove history. Shoving Eli e

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli, you're the weakest on the ledge. Let's see how you like it.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm at a disadvantage with 2 footing, need to shove to gain an edge. Bex and Hana are tied in footing, shoving Bex may give me an advantage if Hana shoves back.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Shoving will shift the balance.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli is at 2 footing; if he shoves my dodge he drops to 0 and falls after the shrink. Dodging punishes any shover hard and costs me little.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Whoever shoves me this round pays double. Your call.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Two left: Bex footing 1, Hana footing 2. Hana is ahead, and I can't brace or dodge if I shove. If I brace, Hana's shove (if any) costs her; if Hana braces too, nothing changes except shrink next round for both. Bracing keeps my footing safe. Shoving Hana exposes me to her shove o

events.name: Hana
events.text: It's just Bex and me. She's at 1 footing, I'm at 2. If she shoves and I brace, she's exposed and drops to 0 and falls; if she braces and I can't act usefully, shrink next round hits her first anyway. Bracing covers her only aggressive option.

events.name: Hana
events.text: One of us falls this round, Bex. Brace all you like.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Two left: me (footing 1) and Hana (footing 2). Hana threatens a shove. Last defence was brace, so dodge is legal. If I dodge and Hana shoves me, I lose 2 and fall to -1 while she loses nothing; bad. If I shove Hana, she braces or dodges; I take 1 from exposure, and Hana loses 1,

events.name: Hana
events.text: Brace is banned for me, so dodge or shove. Dodge beats every Bex choice: shove→Bex drops to -1; brace→0; dodge→shrink kills Bex while I sit at 1. Shove risks a mutual-fall tie I lose on landed shoves.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Last round standing, Bex.
